subject.title: fix(session): stop repeated restart recovery after retry budget

question: Should a maintainer adopt this handoff and complete the current-main rebase plus deprecated Plugin SDK compatibility repair before the PR is reconsidered for merge?
rationale: The remaining work crosses compatibility-sensitive persisted state, shipped Plugin SDK APIs, and current-main concurrency ownership; the branch is not presently landable even though its central behavior is well proven.

options.title: Adopt and finish
options.body: Rebase the reviewed final tree, preserve current-main ownership changes, repair both deprecated whole-store APIs, and rerun exact-merge validation before landing.

options.title: Keep paused
options.body: Leave the PR open as a documented handoff until an area owner has capacity to complete the integration safely.

options.title: Close in favor of another fix
options.body: Close only if a different viable PR implements the same state-machine guarantees with equal or stronger real behavior and compatibility proof.

recommendation.title: Adopt and finish
recommendation.body: Rebase the reviewed final tree, preserve current-main ownership changes, repair both deprecated whole-store APIs, and rerun exact-merge validation before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent context on the final architecture, conflict inventory, SDK boundary, and validation history.
